## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: Energy and Financials showing clear upside while Technology is net weak, and there is a major divergence across large caps with multiple RECOVERY/CORRECTION patterns — leadership concentrated across Tech, Energy and Financials.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%), MPC ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.78% | 1M: +7.13%), VLO ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.62% | 1M: +10.58%). Financials strong: SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.32%), V ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.29% | 1M: +7.40%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Technology lagging/in rotation with mixed internals: AMD CORRECTION (1W: -10.93% | 1M: +10.94%), INTC CORRECTION (1W: -21.05% | 1M: +11.16%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +2.01% | 1M: -0.48%). Consumer Discretionary and Materials also showing weakness: TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +0.78%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -9.26%).

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +13.33% | 1M: -2.44%), PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%), OXY RECOVERY (1W: +10.34% | 1M: -5.43%), ACN RECOVERY (1W: +10.25% | 1M: -23.04%), SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%). Leadership: Moderate concentration (3/5 across Tech, Energy, Financials); Style: Value/Cyclical favored.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: ETN CORRECTION (1W: -6.23% | 1M: +0.91%), TSLA CORRECTION (1W: -6.31% | 1M: +0.78%), FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -9.26%), AMD CORRECTION (1W: -10.93% | 1M: +10.94%), CAT CORRECTION (1W: -10.97% | 1M: +4.84%). Weakness concentrated in Industrials and select Tech hardware names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Top 1W movers: PLTR (1W: +13.33%), PSX (1W: +11.10%), ACN (1W: +10.25%), SCHW (1W: +10.22%), CME (1W: +10.07%). Note MAJOR DIVERGENCE across megacaps (many showing 1W up vs 1M down) — tactical moves, not uniform trend confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed/rotational; large-cap software and semis show short-term bounces but chip names show CORRECTION patterns: AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%), MSFT RECOVERY (1W: +2.77% | 1M: -8.00%), AMD CORRECTION (1W: -10.93% | 1M: +10.94%). Sector internals uneven and headline-driven; monitor for follow-through.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive and broad: SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%), JPM ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.46% | 1M: +6.32%), MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.22% | 1M: +5.86%). Sector showing durable strength and confirming part of the NEUTRAL regime’s upside tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Defensive bid intact with several leaders ABOVE TREND: JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.71% | 1M: +13.16%), UNH ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.40% | 1M: +7.15%), LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.37% | 1M: +7.46%). Watch PFE BELOW TREND (1W: -0.12% | 1M: -7.64%) for selective weakness.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Financials and Energy exposure (e.g., SCHW, JPM, PSX, MPC) while reducing exposure to names with CORRECTION risk in semiconductors and industrial beat-and-reversals (INTC, AMAT, LRCX, CAT). Style: Value/Cyclical favored; remain selective given the megacap divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%), SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%). BEARISH: INTC CORRECTION (1W: -21.05% | 1M: +11.16%), AMAT CORRECTION (1W: -21.09% | 1M: +25.94%), LRCX CORRECTION (1W: -23.12% | 1M: +9.93%).

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +6.51% | 1M: -1.09%) and Financials (1W: +2.55% | 1M: +5.28%) as near-term leaders. BEARISH: Technology showing internal strain (1W: -0.48% | 1M: -0.64%) and Consumer Discretionary underperforming (1W: -1.26% | 1M: -0.69%).

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
Watch NVDA for fail/hold at this week’s low as a trigger for wider tech weakness; AAPL hold above this week’s breakout to confirm continuation of ABOVE TREND; JPM clearing its 1M high would extend Financials strength; INTC break below this week’s low would confirm CORRECTION continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JNJ (+80): Dual-energy catheter approval — JNJ ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.71% | 1M: +13.16%) — sentiment confirmed by price. AAPL (+60): Broadcom deal headline — AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%) — sentiment confirmed. OXY (+55): Evercore upgrade/oil spike — OXY RECOVERY (1W: +10.34% | 1M: -5.43%) — price confirms near-term accumulation.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-45): CEO comment on AI slowdown — META ABOVE TREND (1W: +7.07% | 1M: +1.80%) — sentiment diverging from price (distribution risk). PLTR (-45): political/contract fears — PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +13.33% | 1M: -2.44%) — negative headlines while price spikes = tactical risk. FCX (-45): guidance cut concerns — FCX BELOW TREND (1W: -8.57% | 1M: -9.26%) — sentiment confirmed by weakness.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Value/Cyclical style favored. PSX ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.10% | 1M: +2.58%), SCHW ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +14.48%), AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.30% | 1M: +1.97%) showing relative strength. Key risk: major megacap divergence (multiple RECOVERY vs several CORRECTION cases) and mixed news flow on META/PLTR — monitor for trend confirmation or break.
